reply:
Good afternoon Chidi. Before resending, I checked the transfer's final status directly with Access Bank, and it turns out the payment actually went through.

- Ledgerline's record shows TRF-INV-88 (₦250,000 to Access Bank 0234567891) as "failed", but that status is out of sync with the bank.
- Access Bank confirms the transfer was successful: ₦250,000 was credited to account 0234567891 on 21 November 2026 at 14:02, session ID 000014261121140211000088.

Because the bank confirms the money was credited to your account, resending would risk paying you twice, so I have not sent another transfer.

Please check your statement or with Access Bank using the session ID above as proof of the credit. If your bank confirms the funds genuinely never arrived despite this confirmation, reply and I'll escalate it to our team for a full investigation. Based on Access Bank's records, though, the ₦250,000 is in your account.
